name: Hosokura Tooru
source:
He feels guilty that his parents ended up divorcing. The cause for their fights was Tooru not going to school.

His father feels the same way. He tells Tooru to "do what you think is good for you".

Since his father tends to travel for work, he is often home alone all day long.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bmwp.htmll]official site[/url]]
